sents.t: Lily has found a new apartment!
Her old place was small and far from the café.
The new one is a two-bedroom apartment on Oak Street, and she’s going to share it with a roommate, her friend Priya.
Lily asked me to see it with her.
The landlord showed us the kitchen, the bathroom, and the bedrooms.
“The rent is fourteen hundred dollars a month, and utilities are not included,” she said.
“You have to pay the first month’s rent and a security deposit.”
On moving day, it was raining, of course.
We rented a moving truck and carried boxes for five hours.
Lily has so many cookbooks and baking supplies!
Her couch didn’t fit through the door, so we had to take off its legs.
We were exhausted, and our backs hurt.
We ate pizza on the floor between the boxes.
“Next time, let’s hire movers,” Carlos laughed.
